name: Gracely
shortDescription: UK daily-reflection and Bible-study app with scripture memory, small-group study and accountability features.
suitableContexts: Young Christians using personal reflection and scripture-memory tools
Small groups wanting a mobile study, prayer and accountability space

pricing.summary: Gracely is free to use with an optional Pro subscription. The supplier publishes £4.99 per month or £39.99 per year for additional study and accountability features.

tiers.label: Gracely Pro monthly
tiers.detail: Additional study, scripture-memory and accountability features

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier advertises a free trial of Pro features but does not publish its duration on the reviewed page.

gdprInformation: The supplier publishes a privacy policy and account-deletion instructions. The policy describes profile, reflection, prayer-request and conversation data, so churches should assess its suitability before recommending it for sensitive pastoral use.
coreFeatures: Small-group Study Buddy with voice, video and chat

uk-operator.value: Gracely's terms identify KQ Technology Ltd, company number 17161786, as its England-and-Wales operator.

pricing.value: Supplier publishes a £4.99 monthly and £39.99 annual Pro subscription.

current-app.value: Google Play lists Gracely as a Christian spiritual-growth app made by KQ Technology Ltd and shows a June 2026 update.

editorial.assessment: Gracely is a new personal and small-group spiritual-growth app, not a church-management platform or a replacement for safeguarding-aware pastoral systems. Its daily reflection, scripture-memory and accountability tools may be useful to individuals or voluntary study groups, but its social features require careful local guidance.
bestFor: Individuals who want a mobile daily-reflection and scripture-memory habit
Adult small groups choosing a lightweight study and accountability tool
strengths: Free starting point with published GBP Pro pricing
Current UK operator and public privacy information
Study, reflection and small-group features are connected in one app
limitations: New product with a short operating history
Not a church-management, safeguarding or formal pastoral-record system
Social features and sensitive prayer content need clear local boundaries

procurementVerdict.problem: Personal or small-group spiritual habits that need more structure than a reading plan
procurementVerdict.differentiator: Combines reflection, scripture memory and accountable study in a mobile app
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Review the privacy policy and test group permissions before inviting a church group to use it
